strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Dynamic Resolution using Domain Generation Algorithms.

analytics.name: Analytic 1178
analytics.guidance: Correlate DNS queries that generate domains with high entropy or gibberish patterns, combined with short-lived connections from unusual processes. Monitor Sysmon DNS events and Windows Security logs for abnormal query rates and failed lookups.

tuning.description: Set threshold for randomness in queried domain strings (e.g., >4.0)
Failed resolution ratio above normal baseline (e.g., >30%)
Duration for aggregating suspicious DNS queries (e.g., 5–10 min)

analytics.name: Analytic 1179
analytics.guidance: Identify processes issuing repeated DNS queries to random-looking domains with abnormal entropy or word concatenations. Correlate resolver logs with high NXDOMAIN rates and auditd socket connections.

tuning.description: Ratio of failed queries triggering alert (e.g., >40%)
Flag queries to domains registered in last 7–30 days

log_sources.name: linux:syslog
log_sources.channel: Multiple NXDOMAIN responses and high entropy domains

analytics.name: Analytic 1180
analytics.guidance: Monitor unified DNS logs for abnormal domain queries with low lexical similarity to known domains, repeated failed lookups, and random string structures. Cross-check with process logs to confirm unusual origins (non-browser apps).

tuning.description: Exclude trusted CDN and cloud provider domains
Adjust score for word-based vs. letter-based DGAs

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: High entropy domain queries with multiple NXDOMAINs

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Unexpected apps performing repeated DNS lookups

analytics.name: Analytic 1181
analytics.guidance: Use ESXi syslogs to track abnormal DNS query patterns from management agents or VMs. Identify high-frequency, low-TTL, or unresolvable domains as suspicious. Correlate with unusual management plane process activity.

tuning.description: Expected resolver settings for ESXi hosts
Trusted external domains for hypervisor operations

log_sources.name: esxi:syslog
log_sources.channel: Frequent DNS queries with high entropy names or NXDOMAIN results
